## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The new flag should honor `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` so CI jobs can exclude files through the environment as project policy requires.

## Changes

The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that skips files by basename and logs each skip at INFO level. It documents the flag and adds parser, file collection, and archive tests.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the exclusion default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude` argument, the parser supplies `[]`, so the archive includes `.log` files. `.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11` says “Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that configure exclusions through the environment archive files they intended to skip.

## Suggestions

- cli/main.py:33 — tests — Cover literal basename matching in subdirectories — The tests omit the case where `--exclude skip.log` should skip `nested/skip.log`. The existing `*.log` cases would still pass if the matcher received the full path. — A regression from basename matching to full-path matching could leave explicitly excluded files in an archive without failing the tests. — Fix: Extend `test_main_leaves_excluded_files_out_of_the_archive` with a nested file and a literal basename pattern.
